description: This file defines the ClaimRepository interface which extends JpaRepository to manage Claim entities, providing methods to find claims by reference, customer policy, and customer with status.

classes.name: ClaimRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Claim entity extending JpaRepository with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByReference
methods.description: Finds a claim by its unique reference.

methods.name: findByCustomerPolicy
methods.description: Finds claims associated with a specific customer policy.

methods.name: findByCustomerAndStatus
methods.description: Finds claims for a customer filtered by status.
